_comment: Generated by engine/src/bin/corpus.rs --emit. For each database, the phase set this engine puts on the hull. A second implementation must be restricted to these phases, or the comparison measures refused phases rather than numerical error. `systems` is one entry per file: ids are filename stems and are not unique, so consumers that index by id must apply their own rule and say which entry won (see `duplicate_ids`). The four magnetic fields answer four different questions and are easy to confuse: `magnetic_declared` is every phase the file writes TC, NT, BM, BMAG or BMAGN for, whatever became of it; `magnetic_modelled` is those the engine evaluates the term for; `magnetic_without_model` is those with no MAGNETIC type definition, which no implementation can reach; and `magnetic_approximated` says a graded phase was drawn without the term. Select on `magnetic_modelled` to compare residuals where the term is exercised.
